decisions.rationale: Keep the frozen objective. Add a real-machine installation path for macOS, Linux and Windows to installing-java-and-the-ide, as numbered where-to-look / what-to-do / expected-output / how-to-know steps: download source, install, then verify java -version, javac -version and mvn -v with expected output shapes. Keep the PATH-repair practice as the troubleshooting part. Use official vendor or Adoptium/Oracle and Maven docs from the intake snapshot. Do not invent versions.

Rewrite each lab task in README.md as a short numbered procedure: the TODO location, the learner action without giving the implementation, the public-test feedback to expect, and the passing evidence that marks it done.

Refactor the starter into small input-parameterized methods. Public tests call them with several inputs and edge cases. Drop whole-file substring checks. Where an objective truly needs a specific construct, check it structurally per method; otherwise narrow the README claim to what the tests prove. The reference solution stays in private staging; re-record the solved run.
Scope length()/charAt() statements to the ASCII examples, and add one concise note: String length and indexes count UTF-16 char values, and code-point APIs handle general Unicode.
Qualify compound assignment as equivalent for these simple int examples, and add one line noting the implicit cast and single evaluation of the left side.
